sample_design: 30 manually labeled positive source sentences; single annotator
limitations: Positive-only, sentence-selected evaluation; detection recall is measured separately with automatic tool choice.
Gold labels were created by one annotator and severity is an operational data-layer rubric, not a clinical standard.
Entity scoring is bilingual concept matching after deterministic source-self canonicalization.
Partner scoring accepts any explicit member of a multi-drug/class source; it does not measure complete list recall.

alignment.self_reference_resolution: drug_a deterministically canonicalized to the supplied source generic name
alignment.controlled_type_field: type is the evaluation mechanism_type enum; mechanism_type is emitted as an alias for direct scoring
